newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bonds end higher, fired up by data, summit.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bonds end higher, fired up by data, summit.

text.p: Belgian OLOs ended with solid gains on Thursday, driven higher by weaker-than-expected U.S. data and increased hopes of a compromise agreement in the row over the EMU stability pact at next week's Amsterdam summit.
"There's been a lot of volume - its not speculative but outright buying by portfolios," one dealer said.
But he was also cautious, adding that worries about the proposed single European currency would not go away.
"They might reach an agreement on the stability pact...but (attention) will go back to the real issue of the 3.0 percent (deficit criterium) which won't be reached," he added.
